label: Shape Intelligence — Candidate Governance
goal: Build deterministic validation, persistence, and operational governance for provisional Shape candidates.
purpose: Validate objective requirements and control candidate lifecycle without deciding semantic meaning.
success_condition: Only schema-valid, provenance-complete, policy-compliant candidates are stored, with idempotent jobs, durable receipts, controlled retries, and no retrieval/canon side effect.
objectives: Implement receipts, idempotency, budgets, and retries.
Enforce no-auto-promotion and no retrieval side effects.
